newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA SEES TESTING YEAR FOR PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA SEES TESTING YEAR FOR PROFITS.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said on Wednesday that it faced a difficult profit outlook for the current 1997/98 (July/June) year.
"We see a very testing year coming up," CBA managing director David Murray told reporters when asked what profits would do in the coming year.
Murray said margins remained under pressure and costs were also likely to be a factor in the current year.
The bank, one of Australia's big four and with the largest mortgage portfolio, announced a four percent fall in annual net profit before the share market opened.

It said earnings fell to A$1.078 billion for the year to June 30 from A$1.119 billion in 1995/96, with the latest period including an abnormal loss of A$200 million from technology restructuring costs.
